Module net.automatalib.serialization.etf

Class AbstractETFWriter<I,A extends Automaton<?,I,?>>

java.lang.Object
net.automatalib.serialization.etf.writer.AbstractETFWriter<I,A>
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputModelSerializer<I,A>, ModelSerializer<InputModelData<I,A>>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DFA2ETFWriter, Mealy2ETFWriterAlternating, Mealy2ETFWriterIO
public abstract class AbstractETFWriter<I,A extends Automaton<?,I,?>> extends Object implements InputModelSerializer<I,A>
This class provides methods to write automata in LTSmin's ETF format.
